title: Live board stored (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/live, single board, 200)
description: Reader: Alnasl. 200 also for an update older than what is held (applied false, reason older_than_stored): a late retry never undoes a newer move. Refusals (error.response.schema.json): 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner, tournament_hidden, installation_suspended, installation_revoked, address_blocked, relay_key_revoked, relay_key_wrong_tournament, owner_suspended, owner_revoked; 404 tournament_not_published; 409 moves_conflict, board_not_published, live_game_limit (with limit); 422 invalid_request, invalid_fen, invalid_moves (with ply), ply_mismatch, fen_mismatch; 429 rate_limited; 503 publishing_paused, storage_low (with retry_after). A 409 is NOT always moves_conflict: dispatch on `error`.

ply.description: Plies (half-moves) now held for the board.
